English.Char_Desc_80: Hardened, production-grade video, audio, and image media processing engine.
English.Char_Desc_250: AVI Core is a hardened, production-grade media processing tool that wraps FFmpeg into simple commands with CLI and native Windows File Explorer context menu integration.
English.Char_Desc_450: AVI Core is a standalone media processing engine wrapping FFmpeg capabilities. It supports video, audio, and image conversion and compression via command-line interface and direct Windows Explorer context menu integration. Features fast stream copying, audio extraction, image conversion, smart overwrite protection, and automated cleanup without requiring manual FFmpeg or Python setup.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
AVI Core is a hardened, production-grade media processing engine that wraps the power of FFmpeg into simple, human-readable commands. It supports video, audio, and image processing through both a powerful command-line interface (CLI) and native Windows File Explorer integration, allowing you to process media directly from the right-click context menu.
Key Features: - Universal Media Processing: Convert videos, extract audio, mute videos, compress images, and convert image formats seamlessly. - Native Windows File Explorer Integration: Dynamic context menu integration tailored for image, video, and audio files. - Completely Standalone: Includes embedded FFmpeg engine with no manual installation of Python or FFmpeg required. - Powerful CLI & Automation: Simple commands such as `avicore video convert`, `avicore audio extract`, `avicore image compress`. - Safety & Reliability: Smart overwrite protection, automatic cleanup of interrupted conversions, dynamic output naming, and verbose debug options. - Extensive Format Support: * Video: MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, WebM, M4V, FLV, TS * Audio: MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, OGG, M4A * Images: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP
